changes: Static TrueType regular instance derived from the official variable font at weight 400 using fontTools 4.61.1 varLib.instancer.instantiateVariableFont(font, {wght: 400}, inplace=False, optimize=True). Original outlines, character coverage and attribution are retained; variation tables are removed. Family/style name records normalized to Noto Sans SC Regular; OS/2 weight and style flags set to regular. Reserved Font Name Source is not used. Original head timestamps retained for reproducibility.
